description: email.rs apply_body_value_args (~line 1147): the body_properties HashSet<&str> (prop_set) is rebuilt inside apply_body_value_args on every call, which is invoked once per email in the Email/get response list (see the per-email closure at ~line 441). For a batch get of N emails with B body properties each, this allocates and hashes B strings N times. The HashSet should be built once before the per-email loop and passed in (or the signature changed to accept a pre-built &HashSet<&str>). Impact grows linearly with batch size and is proportional to the number of body properties.
title: apply_body_value_args: body_properties HashSet rebuilt per email
